articles.title: Carney backs latest U.S. strikes on Iran as Trump slams NATO allies
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney endorsed recent U.S. strikes on Iran as justified response to ceasefire violations during NATO summit in Turkey.

articles.title: Carney appoints one of his top advisers and a Conservative MP to Senate
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney appointed longtime Liberal strategist Tim Pitfield and Conservative MP Richard Martel to the Senate, signalling a shift away from non-partisan appointments.

articles.title: Submarine showdown: Carney poised to choose Canada's next submarine fleet
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney is expected to announce the winner of Canada's submarine competition, choosing between German TKMS or South Korean Hanwha Ocean before the NATO summit.

articles.title: Carney says Trudeau-era climate plan was 'too expensive' and 'divisive'
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney criticized the previous government's climate plan, stating it was unsustainable, and acknowledged his government's policies will result in higher carbon emissions in coming years.

articles.title: Canadians mark Canada Day as Carney urges unity, heat grips Central Canada
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney delivered a Canada Day address urging national unity, announced Canada will join Eurovision next year, and said the country will host the Francophonie Summit in 2028.
